name: v1.0.0-rc.52
body:
## 中文

* **插件**：请求处理插件可以声明适用的模型和渠道类型，管理员确认一次后自动覆盖新增的渠道和模型（#8335、#8341）。提供商插件的路由可以按渠道单独开关（#8482）。插件市场支持一键更新全部已安装插件（#8413）。放宽了插件响应和 JSON 克隆的大小限制。
* **模型广场**：新增「推荐」「请求最多」「Token 最多」排序，默认按推荐；模型管理里可设置手动顺序或按近 1/7/30 天用量排序。
* **转发**：高级自定义渠道和提供商插件可以把 `/v1/responses` 转成 Anthropic Messages（#8465）。Claude 工具的 `input_schema` 顶层有 oneOf/anyOf/allOf 时自动展平，Codex Desktop 转 Claude 不再 400（#8476）。所有分组都没有配置的模型返回 404 `model_not_found`，不再返回 503 让 SDK 重试（#8480）。请求内容引起的本地错误不再重试其他渠道，也不再自动禁用渠道（#8345）。
* **计费**：Gemini 音频 inlineData 在缺少 usage 时按时长计费，不再按图片计（#8193）。Claude 的 `thinking_tokens` 记为推理 token（#8431）。缓存计费在编辑器、定价页和日志里统一显示为 GPT 30 分钟/12 小时、Claude 5 分钟/1 小时等类别。
* **模型与任务**：新增 doubao-seedream-5-5（#8324）、海螺 MiniMax-H3-Max（#8453），可灵 kling-4.0 支持 4:3 和 3:4（#8348）。Gemini 4 的思考等级按模型映射（#8367、#8412）。修复了私有渠道的任务媒体下载（#8199）、进度 100% 但未结束的任务停止轮询（#8201）和图片任务插件参数覆盖（#8027）。
* **其他**：批量设置渠道标签后渠道能力立即按新标签重建。插件 API v1 拆为独立模块 `pluginkit`，其他程序可以直接引用（#8475）。

## English

* **Plugins**: Request processing plugins can declare the models and channel types they are made for; after an administrator confirms once, they cover new channels and models automatically (#8335, #8341). Provider plugin routes can be switched on or off per channel (#8482). The plugin marketplace can update every installed plugin at once (#8413). Plugin response and JSON clone size limits are higher.
* **Model square**: New Recommended, Most requests and Most tokens sorts, with Recommended as the default; model management can set a manual order or sort by usage over the last 1, 7 or 30 days.
* **Relay**: Advanced Custom channels and provider plugins can route `/v1/responses` to Anthropic Messages (#8465). Claude tool `input_schema` with a top-level oneOf/anyOf/allOf is flattened, so Codex Desktop through Claude no longer gets a 400 (#8476). A model configured in none of the eligible groups returns 404 `model_not_found` instead of a 503 that SDKs retry (#8480). Local errors caused by the request are no longer retried on other channels and no longer disable channels (#8345).
* **Billing**: Gemini audio inlineData is billed by length, not as images, when usage is missing (#8193). Claude `thinking_tokens` count as reasoning tokens (#8431). Cache pricing shows the same categories (GPT 30m/12h, Claude 5m/1h and others) in the editor, pricing pages and logs.
* **Models and tasks**: Added doubao-seedream-5-5 (#8324) and Hailuo MiniMax-H3-Max (#8453); Kling kling-4.0 supports 4:3 and 3:4 (#8348). Gemini 4 thinking levels are mapped per model (#8367, #8412). Fixed task media downloads on private channels (#8199), polling stopping for unfinished tasks at 100% progress (#8201) and image task plugin parameter overrides (#8027).
* **Also**: Batch tag changes rebuild channel abilities with the new tags right away. Plugin API v1 is now the standalone `pluginkit` module that other programs can import (#8475).

---

* fix(relaykit): Claude input_schema 顶层 oneOf/anyOf/allOf 展平为单一对象 by @Calcium-Ion in https://github.com/QuantumNous/new-api/pull/8476
* fix(pluginkit): 单独构建时使用仓库内的 relaykit by @Calcium-Ion in https://github.com/QuantumNous/new-api/pull/8477
* feat(hailuo): support MiniMax-H3-Max with its own durations, resolutions and usage profile by @feitianbubu in https://github.com/QuantumNous/new-api/pull/8453
* feat(relay): allow openai_responses_to_claude_messages in Advanced Custom and plugin relay routes by @zwenooo in https://github.com/QuantumNous/new-api/pull/8465
* feat(plugin): 提供商插件的路由可按渠道配置开关（enabled_by） by @Calcium-Ion in https://github.com/QuantumNous/new-api/pull/8478
* Revert "feat(plugin): 提供商插件的路由可按渠道配置开关（enabled_by）" by @Calcium-Ion in https://github.com/QuantumNous/new-api/pull/8479
* fix(relay): return 404 for models missing from all eligible groups by @Calcium-Ion in https://github.com/QuantumNous/new-api/pull/8480
* feat(plugin): 插件渠道可按渠道开关提供商插件的路由 by @Calcium-Ion in https://github.com/QuantumNous/new-api/pull/8482
